entries.subject: DAMIT 298: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-298.txt. Model 298, version 2011-02-18, pole (221°, -47°), period 8.58189 h match the retained metadata. The archive diameter field is 187 ±20 km; its applicability to our scale is a separate calibration decision. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Shape and spin alternatives
entries.finding: [Alternative pole and 198 km calibrated shape.](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/asteroid_models/view/299) — excluded alternative solution. The package preserves model 298 and its own spin/scale rather than mixing solutions. The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 299: pole (44°, 17°), 8.58191 h, version 2011-02-18, archive diameter 198 km. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: A released numerical replacement or independent pole/size constraints that distinguish the recorded alternatives, followed by comparison against the currently selected model.
